```{python}
import os
import sys
import json
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns

HERE = Path(os.getcwd())
if str(HERE) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))

import onboarding_utils as ou

NAS_FILE = '/Volumes/Shared/DataCollections/Standardized_SingleCell_Datasets/JooM_2025_41097818/output/diabetes.h5ad'
NAME = 'Diabetes'
EXPECTED = {"cells": 264235, "samples": 52, "ct_types": 13}

SAMPLE_COL = 'file_id'
BIO_COL = 'disease'
BATCH_COLS = ['study', 'batch']
CT_COL = 'cell_type'

ds_data = ou.load_onboarding_dataset_or_subset(NAME, NAS_FILE, HERE)
mode = ds_data["mode"]
sub = ds_data["sub"]
adata = ds_data["adata"]
meta_info = ds_data["meta"]

if mode == "nas" or sub is None:
    cand = ou.candidate_col_detection(adata.obs)
    SAMPLE_COL = SAMPLE_COL if SAMPLE_COL in adata.obs.columns else cand["sample"][0]
    BIO_COL = BIO_COL if BIO_COL in adata.obs.columns else cand["label"][0]
    CT_COL = CT_COL if CT_COL in adata.obs.columns else cand["cell_type"][0]
    BATCH_COLS = [c for c in BATCH_COLS if c in adata.obs.columns] or cand["batch"][:2]
    sub, _ = ou.subset_by_samples(adata, sample_col=SAMPLE_COL, bio_col=BIO_COL, batch_cols=BATCH_COLS, ct_col=CT_COL)
```

## 1. Study Summary & Cohort Overview

> **Diabetes (mouse)** -- Hrovatin et al. 2023, *Nature Metabolism* 5:1615-1632, PMID 37697055. 264,235 single cells from 52 samples across 9 integrated studies (Normal, EPD, Types I & II). Note: mouse gene symbols require ortholog conversion if included in human-gene benchmark methods.

```{python}
if mode == "subset" and meta_info.get("paper_table_compare"):
    cmp_df = pd.DataFrame(meta_info["paper_table_compare"])
else:
    obs_for_cmp = adata.obs if mode == "nas" else sub.obs
    cmp_df = ou.paper_table_compare(obs_for_cmp, SAMPLE_COL, CT_COL, EXPECTED)
cmp_df
```

```{python}
cols_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "Role": ["Sample ID", "Biological Condition", "Batch Candidate(s)", "Cell Type Annotation"],
    "Resolved Column": [SAMPLE_COL, BIO_COL, ", ".join(BATCH_COLS), CT_COL],
    "Unique Levels": [sub.obs[SAMPLE_COL].nunique(), sub.obs[BIO_COL].nunique(), ", ".join(f"{c} ({sub.obs[c].nunique()})" for c in BATCH_COLS), sub.obs[CT_COL].nunique()],
})
cols_summary
```

```{python}
counts = sub.obs[SAMPLE_COL].value_counts().sort_values(ascending=False)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3))
ax.bar(counts.index.astype(str), counts.values, color="#4C72B0")
ax.set_title(f"Cells per Sample ({SAMPLE_COL}) - Diagnostic Subset", fontweight="bold", fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel("Number of Cells")
ax.set_xlabel("Sample")
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 2. Raw Count Integrity Check

```{python}
if mode == "subset" and meta_info.get("count_sanity"):
    cs = meta_info["count_sanity"]
else:
    cs = ou.count_sanity_check(sub)

cs_df = pd.DataFrame([
    {"Metric": "Count Layer / Slot", "Value": str(cs.get("slot"))},
    {"Metric": "Verdict", "Value": str(cs.get("verdict"))},
    {"Metric": "Integer Counts", "Value": str(cs.get("integer_values"))},
    {"Metric": "Sparsity (% Nonzero)", "Value": f"{cs.get('nonzero_frac', 0) * 100:.2f}%"},
    {"Metric": "Sampled Values Range", "Value": f"[{cs.get('min_sample', 0):.1f}, {cs.get('max_sample', 0):.1f}]"},
])
cs_df
```

## 3. Confounding & Experimental Design

```{python}
if mode == "subset" and meta_info.get("confounding_crosstab"):
    crosstab = pd.DataFrame(meta_info["confounding_crosstab"])
else:
    crosstab = ou.confounding_crosstab(sub.obs, BIO_COL, BATCH_COLS)
crosstab[["batch_candidate", "n_bio_uniq", "n_batch_uniq", "perfectly_collinear", "strongly_confounded", "warning"]]
```

## 4. Unintegrated Embeddings (Fresh PCA + UMAP)

> **Embedding Protocol:** Computed directly from processed raw counts (total counts normalized to 10k, log1p, 2000 HVGs via Seurat v3 paper flavor, scaled PCA 50 PCs, standard Scanpy UMAP with `min_dist=0.5, spread=1.0`). **No pre-existing or batch-corrected embeddings are used.**

```{python}
label_cols = [c for c in [BIO_COL] + BATCH_COLS + [CT_COL] if c and c in sub.obs.columns]
um = ou.embed_and_umap_workflow(
    sub, label_cols=label_cols, out_dir=None, name=NAME,
    sample_col=SAMPLE_COL,
)
sub_embedded = um["subset"]

for fig in um["figs"]:
    plt.figure(fig.number)
    plt.show()
```

## 5. Cell-Level Separation (LISI) & Batch Effect Assessment

```{python}
sep_df, json_summary = ou.run_onboarding_metrics(
    sub_embedded, ct_col=CT_COL, bio_col=BIO_COL,
    batch_cols=BATCH_COLS, sample_col=SAMPLE_COL,
)
```

```{python}
fig_hm = ou.plot_separation_heatmap(sep_df, name=NAME)
```
